welcome into the church and parish family rosie marion mary hutchinson, rueben donal mcnulty, nina mae armstrong, sophia catherine mccrea, fionn pollin- mcandrew, sophia grace herbert, mathew conor jackson who were baptised this month in st brigid’s november - month of the holy souls during november, masses will be offered for those whose names are included in the november lists of the dead. envelopes and lists will be available in the porch from this weekend. please leave completed envelopes in the box provided. memorial notice board there will also be a memorial notice board in the entrance hall of the church f or the month of november for parishioners to add memoriam cards . feast of all saints – sunday 1st november (holy day) mass time: 6.00pm vigil, 9.30am, 12 noon all souls day – monday 2nd november mass time: 7.00pm annual mass for recently departed parishioners (november 2025 – november 2026) monday 9th november at 7.00 pm relatives and friends of those who have died since 1st november 2025 are particularly invited to this mass. also remembered are all the departed priests and parishioners of the parish, as well as relatives of parishioners who have died in other parishes during the year. candles will be available for those who wish to bring a lighted candle to the altar in memory of a loved one. food bank collection st brigid’s support to the south belfast foodbank makes a huge difference to the lives of people living in poverty. non perishable food items can be donated after all masses on the 31st october/1st november 2026. the october collection weighed in at 214.95kgs. thank you for your support. list of items currently most needed: tinned fish; tinned meat; tinned vegetables; tinned tomatoes; rice; rice pudding and custard; coffee; tea; cooking sauces; uht milk; jam/honey/spreads; biscuits; large sized nappies(5+); deterg ent; toilet roll; toiletries st. brigid’s apostolic work we would like to thank all parishioners who gave generously to the collecti on mission sunday. the apostolic work continues to support those in need during this difficult time. if you are in a position to help you can donate by a single payment or set up a standing order and credit apostolic work, account no: 00067017 at a. i. b sort code: 93-80-92 if you are a tax payer and wish to gift aid your donation please insert your name house number and post code in the reference box when making your payment. cheques made payable to apostolic work. further information available from thérèse o’reilly through the parish office. thank you for your continued support and god bless you all chaplet of divine mercy you are warmly invited to join us as we pray the chaplet of divine mercy in st brigid’s church every friday at 3pm. it’s a beautiful way to start the weekend! jesus said to sister faustina: at 3 o’clock, implore my mercy especially for sinners…. this is the hour of great mercy for the whole world. in this hour i will refuse nothing to the soul that makes a request of me in virtue of my passion.

á as november dead list in november we remember our dead relatives, friends and past parishioners. fr stephen will offer mass & prayers each day for the dead of our parish. we are particularly encouraging families to come and attend mass together. we would like each family to recall the names of the dead and place them on the november dead list, which they can find in the porch of the church. it is traditional that a stipend is offered, but this is not a requirement for the dead of your families to be remembered, this is simply an offering to fr stephen for the masses celebrated throughout the month of november. our remembrance mass for our parishioners who have passed away this year will be held on friday 27th november at 7pm eternal rest grant unto them, o lord, and let perpetual light shine upon them. may their souls and the souls of all the faithful departed, through the mercy of god, rest in peace. amen ppc news: holywood parish pastoral council invite you to a talk by kevin bell repatriation trust on thursday 5th nov at 7pm in the church. the kevin bell repatriation trust provides practical and emotional support to families who have lost a loved one aboard. they help with the repatriation of the deceased and offer guidance, care and assistance throughout the process, at a very difficult time. everyone is welcome to the talk. a collection for the kevin bell repatriation trust will be taken up on the night. remembering our departed we pray for those who have died recently and for those whose anniversaries occur around this time.
